phase_policies.applies_when: At around 3 minutes, opponent's army composition is unknown but they have heavy economy and technology; you have heavy economy and production.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you gain more scouting information about the opponent's army composition.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize economy and tech, keep ground army flexible, and scout for opponent's tech direction.
phase_policies.target: Continue developing economy and technology while maintaining a flexible army composition; strengthen ground forces as a baseline.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Heavy Economy and Technology Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-extend economy without sufficient army or neglect scouting to identify opponent's tech path.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 4 minutes, both sides have heavy economy and production; opponent likely ground-oriented with Zealots and Stalkers; you have Marines and Marauders.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of an air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on ground army and economy, expand, and keep tech developing; watch for air transition.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army while increasing economy and expansions; maintain defense and technology development.
phase_policies.title: Early-Mid Ground Macro with Heavy Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to a single attack without scouting or neglect anti-air if opponent transitions to air.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 9 minutes, opponent has ground posture with Zealots, Stalkers, Sentries, and Observers; you have ground army with Marines and Marauders.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of an air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain ground army and economy, keep tech and defense, and stay alert for air threats.
phase_policies.target: Continue strengthening ground army and economy; maintain defense and technology development.
phase_policies.title: Mid-Game Ground Macro with Heavy Economy
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if opponent transitions to air or over-invest in ground without flexibility.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 10 minutes, opponent has ground posture with Colossi, Zealots, Stalkers, and Sentries; you have ground army with Siege Tanks, Marines, and Reapers.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of an air transition or heavy pressure.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Boost defense, keep ground army strong, and maintain economy and tech; watch for air.
phase_policies.target: Increase defense and continue developing ground army; maintain economy and technology development.
phase_policies.title: Late-Mid Ground Defense and Development
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air if opponent transitions to air or over-commit to ground without scouting.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
